Install guide

Install Zed on Omarchy

The official route: Install > Editor.

Reviewed 2026-10-23 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Open the Omarchy menu with Super + Space. Choose Install > Editor and pick Zed.

Steps

  1. Open the Omarchy menu with Super + Space.
  2. Choose Install > Editor and pick Zed.
  3. To make it the system-wide default editor, use Setup > Defaults > Editor.

Neovim is Omarchy's default editor; Install > Editor also lists VSCode, Cursor, Sublime Text, Helix, Vim and Emacs. [omarchy.org]

Source

From the official Omarchy manual, checked 2026-10-23. Zed is not a package in the Omarchy repo, so it has no app page here; for repo apps use the apps list.
